title: Failed-regime representation attribution
question: Are the F-AHL10 endpoint-fidelity failures caused primarily by the derivative-consistent retention interpolant, by the log(K) lookup, or by their interaction?
frozen_solver_and_case_policy: Identical to F-AHL10; no gate or regime changes.

attribution_rule.K_lookup_dominated: dc+exactK passes while exact-retention+lookupK remains materially discrepant
attribution_rule.retention_dominated: exact-retention+lookupK passes while dc+exactK remains materially discrepant
attribution_rule.interaction_or_both: neither isolated restoration passes or both are required
